title: Checkout deployment regression runbook
root_cause: A reduced retry_limit can exhaust payment retry attempts.
resolution: After verifying the exact diff and excluding dependencies, propose rollback for human approval and verify error metrics.
pattern: checkout error spike within minutes after config deployment
diagnostic: Correlate metrics with release time; inspect retry.py using ripgrep; compare deployed configuration with last healthy version.
text: Synthetic V2 reference, not evidence of the current incident. A deployment near an error spike is correlation. Confirm the retry configuration diff and retry exhaustion logs; check payment provider, database and cache health before diagnosing a deployment regression. A retry limit change from 5 to 2 reduces tolerance of transient payment failures. Never infer causality from release timing alone. Rollback production requires approval.
